title: Goodwill Points in Paloma Rewards: Agent Authority and Limits
content:
A support agent may grant Paloma Rewards goodwill points only for a service failure Paloma acknowledges on a specific transfer or order.

## When goodwill may be granted

- **Qualifying failure.** The failure must be one Paloma acknowledges on a specific transfer or order: a late delivery already confirmed in the records, or an error resolved in the customer's favour.
- **Not a substitute.** Goodwill is never granted in place of a fee refund or remedy a policy owes, and never because a customer asks for compensation without such a failure.
- **One grant per case.** Each case receives one grant, referenced by the date of the failure's case (YYYY-MM-DD).
- **Membership status.** Goodwill points are granted only while the membership is active.
- **No tier effect.** Goodwill points count toward no tier.

## Limits on the amount

A grant may not exceed the tier's goodwill limit per case, and the goodwill points the member has received in the trailing 12 calendar months ending on the handling date, plus the grant, may not exceed the tier's 12-month goodwill limit. Both limits are read against Paloma's own points history for the membership before the grant is made.

The largest grant allowed for a case is therefore the lower of the per-case limit and what remains of the 12-month limit after the goodwill already received in the window.

## Worked figures (hypothetical limits: 500 points per case, 1500 points per 12 months)

| Goodwill already received in the trailing 12 months | Room left under the 12-month limit | Largest grant allowed |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1500 | 500 (per-case limit) |
| 1000 | 500 | 500 |
| 1200 | 300 | 300 |
| 1500 | 0 | none |

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Goodwill under this rule |
|---|---|
| Late delivery already confirmed in the records for the transfer | May be granted, within the limits |
| Error on an order resolved in the customer's favour | May be granted, within the limits |
| Customer asks for compensation, no acknowledged failure | Not granted |
| A fee refund or remedy is owed by policy | Goodwill does not take its place |
| A grant already made for the same case | No second grant |
| Membership not active | Not granted |
